title: UEFI firmware self-identifies as EDK II (OVMF) in SystemBiosVersion, contradicting the claimed AMI/MSI board
reason: EDK II also runs on physical hardware; BIOS strings remain observational.

title: ACPI DSDT contains QEMU's literal hotplug/GPE container device names
reason: Original hotplug names and remaining ACPI port templates. Generic reserved-resource stubs are not unique VM identifiers.

title: Intel ICH9/Q35 southbridge emulated on a system claiming an AMD Socket AM5 B650 board
reason: Q35/ICH9 alongside AMD CPU is a platform clue, not a CPU specification contradiction.

title: Display adapter is the Bochs/QEMU standard VGA device (VEN_1234&DEV_1111)
reason: Explicit QEMU standard VGA PCI identity; retained SPICE display remains detectable.

title: Boot SSD advertises 'Samsung SSD 990 PRO 2TB' but reports exactly 256 GiB
reason: Smaller NVMe namespaces can exist on real drives. Failed Samsung fetch does not establish a model-specific invariant.

title: CPUID reports no MONITOR/MWAIT, no PCID, and no Core Performance Boost on a CPU identifying as Ryzen 5 9600X
reason: Measure CPB and sparse power profile. Host lacks PCID/MONITOR too; their absence is not a scored contradiction.

title: CPUID takes ~1037 cycles - an unconditional VM exit (bare metal is ~1-2 orders of magnitude cheaper)
reason: Sustained timing has no universal physical threshold; empty/NOP loop is not a physical CPUID control. Existing TIMING_ATTACKS remains separate.

title: Two ACPI tables still carry OVMF's INTEL/EDK2 header IDs while the rest were rewritten to AMI
reason: Header OEM identifiers checked on validated ACPI tables. EDK II also runs physically.

title: ACPI table set is missing every AMD platform table a Ryzen/B650 system must publish
reason: Missing IVRS/CRAT/CDIT is a firmware-profile clue. No assertion these are mandatory on every physical Ryzen configuration.

title: SMBIOS memory array has one 16 GiB DIMM and a maximum capacity equal to the installed capacity
reason: Single memory slot and maximum equal installed capacity, derived from validated SMBIOS fields. Unknown RAM sizes omit the predicate; no mandatory physical slot-count claim.

title: Default gateway's MAC address is in QEMU's 52:54:00 OUI
reason: Cached gateway MAC only; no network probes and no claim that DNS/SSH works.

title: Emulated Intel 82574L NIC and Renesas xHCI on a board whose real I/O is AMD Promontory
reason: Intel NIC and Renesas controller are physical products; motherboard optional/disabled peripherals are not mandatory.

title: PS/2 keyboard, PS/2 mouse and legacy RTC present as ACPI devices on a board with no PS/2 ports
reason: Present ACPI PS/2 pair only. Absence of an external connector does not prove an internal controller impossible; RTC is ordinary.

title: Single ACPI thermal zone pinned at exactly 26.85 C, and NVMe SMART log is mostly empty
reason: Literal thermal AML and known raw SMART defaults are observed. A single temperature does not establish invariance under load. Blank WMI reliability fields are not promoted to a hardware contradiction.

title: Max extended CPUID leaf claims 0x80000022 but the SME/SEV leaf 0x8000001F returns all zeros
reason: In-range all-zero SME/SEV leaf is a clue; maximum leaf does not require every feature to be implemented or enabled.

title: SMBIOS version 2.8 with only 42 structures in 1659 bytes, from a BIOS dated 2024
reason: SMBIOS major/minor and structure count are measured, not treated as a standard violation merely because the BIOS is recent.

title: Flat single-bus PCI topology with 8 devices, no PCIe root ports, no AMD data-fabric functions and no IOMMU
reason: Bus-zero-only Ryzen PCI set with no AMD identities is a topology clue. Disabled IOMMU or missing root-port enumeration alone is not scored.

title: NVMe Identify retains QEMU controller fingerprint and inconsistent total capacity
